Episode 228. The Battle of Grosha Castle (11)
[You've arrived, Jin Runcandel. And the Sword Emperor.]
Sakiel's voice echoed through the air. The voice seemed to emanate from the air itself, so it was impossible to pinpoint her location.
"Why bother with such petty tricks, Sakiel? You can't hide anywhere but inside this castle. Do you want to play hide and seek?"
[It's audacious of you to act like this, considering how you fled from our previous confrontation.]
Jin and Dante heightened their senses.
Sakiel of Grosha. She was a figure who had once threatened Jin and Murakan using the extreme peaks of Hell and Zito's flesh.
At that time, Murakan had destroyed Sakiel's seal before it could be completed, and Jin had managed to escape, making her waste Zito's flesh.
But it was different now.
Regardless of what she had prepared, it was time to confront her directly.
"I hope you don't think that Murakan and I avoided battle out of fear."
[Well, regardless, it's true that you found me burdensome after I received Zito's true power. I am now even more powerful than then.]
Boom-!
Suddenly, an explosion erupted between Jin and Dante. Magic had exploded. The two easily avoided the explosion.
And then, as if on cue, they both unleashed a barrage of sword energy. If they destroyed the castle, Sakiel's whereabouts would naturally be revealed.
The condensed magic in the air resisted their sword energy to some extent. But no matter how dense the magic, it couldn't completely block their sword energy.
Within less than ten seconds, the sword energy began to pierce the castle, penetrating the magic and sticking into it. The impact caused the entire castle to tremble as if it would crumble.

"Show yourself if you dare, or continue hiding. No matter what you choose, the outcome will be the same. It seems like you're mimicking Kelliark Zephyr's spatial explosion. Did you also fall under his command?"
...Did you say 'also'?
Sakiel was momentarily stunned, almost blurting out a question.
She had no idea that Kelliark was gradually taking over the demon lords in the Demon World.
[Me, following Kelliark Zephyr... This is why we demons despise humans.]
"Really?"

"[Living a life of barely a hundred years, and even most of them hardly live a hundred years. Inferior tribes that just live day by day to eat and survive like unintelligent animals, enjoy too many blessings without any good reason. They even possess the earth and the real sun, which even we can't enjoy. I can't stand it.]"
Kwaang-!
The sword energy crumbled the castle gate. The gate, failing to fulfill its function, collapsed lifelessly, and Jin and Dante kicked it away like a pebble.
The desolate landscape was visible beyond the missing gate.
There were no soldiers guarding the gate, nor any inside. Empty buildings and a desolate inner castle.
However, Jin saw traces of hidden magic within the scene.
'The troops inside the castle were sacrificed for some kind of magic. The flow of magic is solidifying, drawing an invisible magic circle.'
Phisshh-!
It wasn't just the gate that their sword energy had destroyed. The magic that Sakiel had laid out was seeping out through the cracks in the destroyed barrier from the inside.

The more the magic faded, the more clearly they felt the magic circle formed by the hardened flow of magic. It was a dark spell unknown to the world, so it was impossible to know exactly what effect it had.

"You should have been patient even if it was hard. What a mess you've made, coveting the surface. Don't you feel sorry for your minions who died outside like dust? Humans may have shorter lives and fewer abilities at birth than you, but they are not as brutal."

"[Everything that exists in the world has its own destined fate. The meaning has faded after the death of the sun god, but we in the demonic realm uphold the order set by Zito and maintain an organized state. The dead soldiers were destined to die for Zito and the demonic realm.]"
"Ah, what a nauseating nonsense... Sakiel Groshae. Then your destiny will also be to fall by our hands today."
As Dante swung his sword, the buildings in the inner castle were swept away and collapsed by his sword energy.

"[It wasn't something I said expecting you to understand. From the standpoint of inferior tribes, it might feel like we are stealing rights. Once Zito's order comes to the surface, you will accept it, whether you like it or not... Ack!]"
Sakiel clutched her chest and groaned.
A thrust at light speed, a streak of sword energy imbued with the power of the underworld king, was piercing through Sakiel's chest, who had been hiding in the inner castle.
'...Have you already precisely determined my location?'
Jin fired another thrust at light speed and narrowed the distance with Sakiel.
"You're not very good at hide and seek."
He sounded relaxed, but Jin remained vigilant.
As Jin expected, Sakiel had used all the flesh that should belong to other Demon Kings alone. A chest wound wasn't enough to inflict any fundamental damage.
Even if his entire body was burned with Eternal Flame, it would take a long time until all the power Sakiel currently held was exhausted. And Sakiel wouldn't just stand by and let it happen.
Wham-! Magic emitted from Sakiel's crystal orb engulfed Jin. Jin and Dante carefully pressured Sakiel, scattering their sword aura to prevent the magic from directly touching their blades.

They felt that if it touched the sword, they wouldn't be able to shake it off easily, and if it attached to their bodies, they wouldn't be able to avoid serious injuries. Sakiel possessed a power that could be called a 'part' of Zito, and it was no exaggeration.
[Is that so? Honestly, I was surprised. Supreme Demons, even though you are not at the state called Transcendence, you managed to find me so quickly.]

"Until now, we've cut down countless opponents who became stronger by borrowing someone else's power, including you. There were even those who surpassed the state of Transcendence based only on the size of their power. Don't overestimate the power of Zito, it's not entirely yours. If your fundamental strength isn't stronger than mine, you will never have a chance to win."
[We'll see about that after the fight…….]
The two swords and Sakiel's magic began to mix.

For a while, Jin and Dante would not be able to fully exert their power, as they would have to fight while avoiding direct exposure to the magic, and blow the magic spread inside the fortress outside for the sake of the incoming allies.
But this was just a matter of time.
Once they became accustomed to the new threat of Zito's magic and drained all the magic from the fortress, the significance of Sakiel's strength would fade.
Boom, kaboom……!

The sound of explosions coming from the outside, from the first line of defense, was getting closer. It was a signal that the golden squadron and the knights were successfully breaking down the defense lines and approaching the fortress.
'But, Sakiel also seems to be strangely passive in the battle…… It doesn't seem like it's just because his close combat ability is relatively weak.'
Both Jin and Dante felt the same.
If they were in Sakiel's position, they would have pushed as hard as possible before the opponent became accustomed to the magic.
'Did he prepare the Dark Realm magic in advance, and is he maintaining that?'
A sense of unease was creeping in.
Jin opened the communication device and gave an order to the main unit outside.
"All forces, stand by for entry. I will issue another command after dealing with Sakiel in the inner fortress. Until then, focus solely on annihilating the defensive line."

{Understood, Leader! Uh, wait……? What's this? Leader! We've just received an urgent report from the Nameless King! There's a report of a tidal wave-like formation of magic appearing at the rear of the left, rear defense line! What!? It's on our side too. It's visible to the naked eye! It's visible in the sky too……!}
Jin reflexively looked up at the sky. Above the collapsed Grosh Castle's ceiling, he could see the massive curtain flickering.
Instinctively, he could tell what form that curtain was taking.
Hemisphere.
A hemisphere-shaped magic that enveloped all sides of the fortress in the Groshen Fortress was rapidly narrowing towards the castle.

"Jin! Did you hear? A curtain of magic has spread across the entire battlefield. It's narrowing too fast, not only our forces, but also the fleets of the Zipple side are taking refuge towards the Groshen Fortress at full speed!"
This was Luna's communication.
If Luna is communicating, it means she can't stop the tightening magic curtain with her power.

"When hit, it seems that the top superhumans can break through and escape the magic. But then we won't be able to protect the rest of the forces. I'll enter the castle while protecting as much as possible. Zipple has already lost all the fleets in the rear."
"As my sister said. Plus, as the magic narrows towards Groshen Fortress, you can see the demons disappearing in heaps. It looks like they are being consumed as sacrifices."
"Understood, keep entering until the magic stops."
All the power of the insurgents who were attacking the defensive line was getting closer to Groshen Castle to avoid the magic. It was the entire force of the alliance, federation, and Kinzelo.
Jin tightened his grip on the sword, looking at Sakiel. The tide of magic that now engulfed the entire battlefield was the identity of the invisible magic circle that Jin had sensed.
Sakiel smiled with a grin.
"It's a magic called the Wall of Death. It's the first time in our history of the underworld that it has been spread on such a scale, so you can think of it as glorious."
Jin drew out the Bradamante. When he cut the magic curtain that covered the sky with a sacred sword, it seemed he could handle it enough.
'When the Wall of Death narrows to its limit and we, the superhumans, cut it all at once, there won't be a big problem.'
Sakiel narrowed his forehead as he watched the sky momentarily open at Jin's gaze.
"I see. You probably drew a picture of the forces hitting the defense line forcibly entering the castle using this magic called the Wall of Death. Then most will die in the magic you spread here."
Sakiel glared at Jin without answering.
"[...] It seems that you are confident to break through the Wall of Death and save your followers. That too, you will know when you see the result."
Crack! Cringe!
Bradamante and Sakiel's crystal ball collided. Sakiel clenched his teeth as he confirmed that cracks were occurring in the crystal ball.
"Magic can't be fully maintained if the magician dies. So whatever tricks you have prepared, it would be best to expose it as quickly as possible. Before you die, that is."
